title: Value of a circuit vertex
statement: Let $g_1,\ldots,g_m$ be Boolean gates, let $x$ be a Boolean assignment to the $n$ input vertices, and let $v$ be a natural-numbered vertex. Evaluate the gates in order after initializing the vertex values with $x$, and take the value at index $v$; if that index is outside the resulting list of values, the value is false.
hypotheses_covered: An assignment of Boolean values to the $n$ input vertices
